name: care-ring
description: Privacy-first real-time family safety platform with live location sharing, geofencing, emergency SOS, real-time chat, trip history, and driver safety analytics.

paragraphs: A privacy-first, high-performance open-source alternative to proprietary family tracking systems.
🌐 Web Landing Page • 📥 Download Android APK • 🚀 Cloud Deployment • ✨ Features • 🧠 How It Works • 📄 MIT License • ⚡ Quickstart
features: 📍 Real-Time GPS Telemetry & 60 FPS Gliding: Sub-100ms WebSocket streaming with physics-based coordinate interpolation (MarkerInterpolator) eliminating map jitter.
⭕ PostGIS Geofenced Safe Zones: Microsecond boundary evaluation via PostGIS STDWithin spatial indexes for instant arrival/departure push alerts.
♾️ Unlimited Movement History & Daily Timelines: Unbounded historical route breadcrumbs, stop durations, and route replay extending back to the day members joined, with zero paywalls.

🚗 Driver Safety Leaderboards & Scorecards: Weekly safety scores (0–100), circle rankings, top speed audits, and 5-point driving event classifications (Speeding, Phone Distraction, Rapid Accel, Hard Braking, Harsh…
🚶 Smart Activity State Machine: Autonomous sensor-fusion engine identifying Stationary, Walking, Running, Driving, and Cycling states, with adaptive GPS sleeping (<1% battery drain/hour).

whatItDoes.text: A privacy-first, high-performance open-source alternative to proprietary family tracking systems.
